execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."CVStatus" AS ENUM ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."ExportFormat" AS ENUM ('PDF', 'DOCX', 'JPG')
CREATE TYPE "public"."ReferenceType" AS ENUM ('PROFESSIONAL', 'ACADEMIC', 'PERSONAL')
CREATE TYPE "public"."SubscriptionPlan" AS ENUM ('FREE', 'PRO', 'BUSINESS')
CREATE TYPE "public"."SubscriptionStatus" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED', 'PAST_DUE')
CREATE TYPE "public"."UsageType" AS ENUM ('CV_CREATE', 'CV_EXPORT', 'AI_REQUEST')
CREATE TYPE "public"."UserRole" AS ENUM ('USER', 'ADMIN', 'OWNER')
CREATE TYPE "public"."Visibility" AS ENUM ('PUBLIC', 'PRIVATE')

CREATE TABLE "public"."Award" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "date" timestamp(3),
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "issuer" text,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CV" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isPublic" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "slug" text,
  "status" "CVStatus" DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::"CVStatus" NOT NULL,
  "templateId" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "visibility" "Visibility" DEFAULT 'PRIVATE'::"Visibility" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CVExport" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "fileSize" int4,
  "fileUrl" text,
  "format" "ExportFormat" NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CVSectionSetting" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isVisible" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "sectionKey" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Certification" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "credentialId" text,
  "credentialUrl" text,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "doesNotExpire" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "expiryDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "issueDate" timestamp(3),
  "issuer" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Conference" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organizer" text,
  "role" text,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Course" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "credentialId" text,
  "credentialUrl" text,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "provider" text,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CustomSection" (
  "content" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isVisible" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Education" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "degree" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "field" text,
  "grade" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "institution" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ExtracurricularActivity" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organization" text,
  "role" text,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Interest" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Language" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "level" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."LeadershipExperience" (
  "achievements" jsonb,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organization" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Membership" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organization" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Patent" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "filingDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "inventors" text,
  "issueDate" timestamp(3),
  "issuer" text,
  "patentNumber" text,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PersonalInformation" (
  "address" text,
  "city" text,
  "country" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "dateOfBirth" text,
  "email" text,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "github" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "instagram" text,
  "lastName" text,
  "linkedin" text,
  "nationality" text,
  "phone" text,
  "postalCode" text,
  "professionalTitle" text,
  "profileImageUrl" text,
  "state" text,
  "twitter" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ProfessionalSummary" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isVisible" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Project" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "repository" text,
  "role" text,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "technologies" jsonb,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Publication" (
  "authors" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "doi" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "issue" text,
  "journal" text,
  "pages" text,
  "publicationDate" timestamp(3),
  "publisher" text,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  "volume" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Reference" (
  "company" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "email" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "position" text,
  "relationship" text,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "type" "ReferenceType" DEFAULT 'PROFESSIONAL'::"ReferenceType" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Skill" (
  "category" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "level" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Subscription" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "plan" "SubscriptionPlan" NOT NULL,
  "provider" text,
  "providerCustomerId" text,
  "providerSubscriptionId" text,
  "startDate" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "status" "SubscriptionStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TeachingExperience" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "institution" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "subject" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Template" (
  "config" jsonb,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isDefault" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "previewUrl" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "version" text DEFAULT '1.0.0' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UsageRecord" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "type" "UsageType" NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "name" text,
  "passwordHash" text,
  "role" "UserRole" DEFAULT 'USER'::"UserRole" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserProfile" (
  "bio" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "location" text,
  "phone" text,
  "portfolio" text,
  "twitter" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,

  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."VolunteerExperience" (
  "achievements" jsonb,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "cvId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "organization" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WorkExperience" (
  "achievements" jsonb,
  "company" text NOT NULL,
  "companyUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,

  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
